forum.title: How to use STM32CubeProgrammer to set the OEM key and RDP0 to RDP2?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @ShimiaoWang,

You can set the RDP level 2 password by writing four 32-bit words into the password field and click on "Set password". If you want to set a password for RDP level 2 with boundary scan, you can write a 32-bit BSKEY.

**Please carefully** refer to [How to set the RDP password keys and levels on STM32C5 MCUs - stm32mcu](https://wiki.st.com/stm32mcu/wiki/Security:How_to_RDP_password_and_regression_on_STM32C5) and [STM32CubeProgrammer software description - User manual](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um2237-stm32cubeprogrammer-software-description-stmicroelectronics.pdf) before any manipulation.

PS: @MGogr.1, STM32CubeProgrammer v2.22.0 supports STM32C5 and the message has been changed as per the screenshot from @ShimiaoWang.

Aziz
